## What changed

One or two sentences, and how you checked it.

## Release

The changeset and its bump (patch, minor or major, by `packages/design-system/COMPATIBILITY.md`), or "no
change to what the package ships". For a visual change, what an app should look at in its screenshots.

## Open items

Closed: the `docs/state.md` items this settles. Opened: what is now unverified, each with `closed when:`.
Or "none".

## Shared files

Any shared stylesheet (`primitives.css`, `buttons.css`, `tokens.css`) or token in
`git diff --stat origin/main`, and why. Otherwise "none".

## Review

The tier (0, 1 or 2, AGENTS.md); for Tier 2, the review pass you ran with your tool's review command, or
why it did not run; Greptile's last reviewed commit, or why none.
